name: HRA crypt field (2D)
blurb: A 2D epithelium initialized from the Human Reference Atlas: a field of intestinal crypts of Lieberkühn, each an exact copy of the HRA 2D-FTU cell layout — ~6,700 real Absorptive / Goblet / Stem / Neuroendocrine / Tuft cells relaxing under vertex mechanics. Colour by cell type to see the real HRA cell identities at scale.
